grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, eggs, milk, butter, honey, Greek yoghurt and fresh peaches are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item, and peaches or nectarines are cheap and plentiful in September.

basic_kitchen.reason: A bowl, a whisk and a frying pan are all it needs, and the technique is simple pancake frying.

works.reason: 200g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 250ml milk make a thick batter for about a dozen pancakes, which suits four, and the frying times are sensible.

honest_times.reason: Thirty active minutes covers mixing, slicing four peaches and frying the pancakes in batches at the hob.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm honeyed peaches suit mid-September, and four peaches make them the clear point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British instructions with no restaurant flourishes or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, milk, Greek yoghurt and a whole peach each make this a proper breakfast rather than just sugar and starch.
